name: kite
description: Hosted MCP server for Kite (kite.new), a design tool your AI agents and your team share. Agents draw real, editable layers (frames, text, components, auto layout) in the same file your team edits live, and any frame can be copied as HTML, React or Tailwind. Free plan: unlimited editors, 3 files, 100 agent actions a day.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint with OAuth sign-in. Requires a Kite account (free plan available).

examples.title: Design a screen
examples.description: Draw an editable UI in a shared file
examples.prompt: Create a pricing page in my Kite file with three plan cards using auto layout.

examples.title: Export to code
examples.prompt: Copy the Settings frame from Kite as React with Tailwind classes.
